description: This file 'connect.h' defines interfaces, macros, and function declarations related to establishing network connections, protocol negotiation, and server feature support in a Git client implementation.

methods.name: git_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection based on provided file descriptors, URL, and flags.

methods.name: finish_connect
methods.description: Completes the connection process for a given child process.

methods.name: git_connection_is_socket
methods.description: Checks if the connection is a socket.

methods.name: server_supports
methods.description: Determines if the server supports a specific feature.

methods.name: parse_feature_request
methods.description: Parses feature requests for server capabilities.

methods.name: server_feature_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a server feature.

methods.name: url_is_local_not_ssh
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to a local resource without SSH.

methods.name: discover_version
methods.description: Discovers the protocol version of the server.

methods.name: server_supports_hash
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a specific hash algorithm.

methods.name: server_supports_v2
methods.description: Checks if server supports protocol v2.

methods.name: ensure_server_supports_v2
methods.description: Ensures that server supports protocol v2.

methods.name: server_feature_v2
methods.description: Gets version 2 feature details from the server.

methods.name: server_supports_feature
methods.description: Checks server support for a specific feature, with error handling.

methods.name: check_stateless_delimiter
methods.description: Checks for a stateless delimiter in RPC communication.
